summary: Calneh is a city in the land of Shinar. Genesis lists it with Babel, Erech and Akkad at the beginning of Nimrod’s kingdom.

senses.definition: A city in Shinar named among the first centers of Nimrod’s kingdom.

evidence.note: Calneh is the last of four places listed before בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר, “in the land of Shinar.”
